title: 4-Way Tap Connector – Hose Splitter with Shut-Off
descriptionHtml:
One tap – four hoses, zero hassle

Constantly unscrewing and swapping hoses between the watering can, the drip hose and the spray nozzle is both time-consuming and annoying. And it usually sprays water exactly where you don't want it.

Connect everything at once

With this 4-way tap connector you connect up to four hoses at the same time from the same tap. Each outlet has its own on/off valve so you control exactly where the water goes – without unscrewing anything.

Features

  • Four separate outlets with individual valves
  • Control the flow to each hose independently of the others
  • Fits standard garden taps and quick connectors
  • Perfect for irrigation systems, drip hose and rinsing
  • Durable material that handles outdoor use season after season

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
